name: ascet_state_machine_read
description: Read state-machine source slots, stored method text versions and supported graphical Init methods in one fresh component read. Includes diagram identities, hashes, method metadata, binding links and graphical_bodies with nodes, GET/SET ports, connections and execution sequence. Graphical documents use kind=graphical_method, variant=BD, language=ascet_graph and representation=graphical_model; derived assignments are not original ESDL or generated C. Supports direct scalar assignments from literal/local getter nodes; unknown operators, nested graphs and ambiguous storage are partial with errors and unread_method_bodies. Trigger events use body_status=state_machine_event. complete is scoped to state_machine_source_bundle_v2, excluding state transition topology, external component interface layout/caller wiring, generated code, editor buffers and transitive callees. Same persistent JSONL process as ascet_code_search; operation must be read_state_machine.
